findings.issue: מְלֹא is a construct noun, the fullness measured by the omer, and מָן is the substance. 'lleno del ómer' means 'full of the omer', so the omer becomes the contents instead of the measure.
שָׁמָּה is an adverb with directional he (thither); 'allí' smooths it to a static location.

notes: Speech formula, tú imperatives, 3ms object, Jehová, and 2mp 'ustedes' match the tokens.
